name: garmin-claude-connector
description: Your own Garmin data in Claude: a private, password-protected MCP connector on Cloudflare Workers using Garmin's Personal API key.

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin **Personal API key**. Create one in Garmin Connect under [Settings → Personal API token](https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken).

LOGIN_PASSWORD.description: A **new, long password** (20+ characters) that you invent now. You type it once when connecting Claude. Save it in your password manager.

OAUTH_KV.description: Storage for login sessions. Created automatically, leave as is.
